newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE--Rock Hill School District #3, S.C..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE--Rock Hill School District #3, S.C..

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF SALE
$26,000,000 General Obligation Bonds, Series 1997A
$2,500,000 General Obligation Bonds, Series 1997B
of Rock Hill School District No. 3 of York County,
South Carolina
Time and Place of Sale: Proposals addressed to th
Superintendent of Rock Hill School District No. 3 of York County, South Carolina (the
School District '') will
received in the Board Room of the School District, 660 North Anderson Road, Rock Hill, South Carolina 29730, until 12:00 Noon, South Carolina time, on
Wednesday, July 9, 1997,

at which time said proposals will be publicly opened for the purchase of $26,000,000 General Obligation Bonds, Series 1997A (the Series 1997A Bonds'') and $2,500,000 General Obligation Bonds, Series 1997B (the Series 1997B Bonds''), of the School District (the Series 1997A and the Series 1997B Bonds are together referred to as the
Bonds'

Terms and conditions will be governed by the Official Notice of Sale. The Bonds: The Bonds will be issued initially under the DTC Book-Entry Only System. Each series of Bonds will be dated as of July 1, 1997, will be in denominations of $5,000 each or any integral multiple thereof not exceeding the principal amount of such series of Bonds maturing in a year; will be numbered from R-1 upward; and will mature serially on March 1 in each of the years and in the principal amounts as follows:
(March 1)Principal(March 1) Principal(March 1) Principal
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount
(March 1)Principal(March 1) Principal(March 1) Principal
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount
1999 200,000 2001 550,000 2003 575,000 Each series of Bonds will bear interest from the date thereof payable on each March 1 and September 1 beginning on March 1, 1998, until they mature.
Redemption: The Series 1997B Bonds are not subject to redemption prior to their stated maturities.

The Series 1997A Bonds maturing on or prior to March 1, 2006, are not subject to redemption prior to their stated maturities. The Series 1997A Bonds maturing on or after March 1, 2007, are subject to redemption as more fully described in the Official Notice of Sale.
Security: The Bonds shall constitute binding general obligations of the School District and the full faith,
credit, resources and taxing power of the School Dis are irrevocably pledged for the payment of the Bonds.
Bids for Separate Offerings: Separate bids must be
submitted for each series of Bonds.

Bid Requirements: Bidders shall specify the rate or rates of interest per annum which the Bonds of a series are to bear, to be expressed in multiples of 1/20 or 1/8 of 1%, with no greater difference than 3% between the highest and lowest rates of interest named for the Series 1997A Bonds and no greater difference than 2% between the highest and lowest rates of interest named for the Series 1997B Bonds.
Award of Bonds: The Series 1997A Bonds and the Series 1997B Bonds will be awarded separately to the bidder or bidders offering to purchase the Bonds of such series at
the lowest interest cost to the School District, such cost to be determined in accordance with the true interest cost (TIC) method.
Good Faith Deposit or
: Each propos

Series 1997A Bonds shall be accompanied by a certified or cashier's check drawn upon an incorporated bank or trust company in the amount of $250,000 payable unconditionally to the Treasurer of York County, South Carolina. Each proposal for the Series 1997B Bonds shall be accompanied by a certified or cashier's check drawn upon an incorporated bank or trust company in the amount of $50,000 payable
unconditionally to the Treasurer of York County, South Carolina.
In lieu of providing a good faith check, a bidder may use the SureBid system.
Legal Opinion: The legality of the Bonds will be approved by Sinkler & Boyd, P.A.
Continuing Disclosure: A description of the School
District's undertaking is set forth in the preliminary Official Statement and will also be set forth in the final Official Statement.

Additional information: For copies of the preliminary Official Statement and Official Notice of Sale, please contact William L. Hirata, Esq., Sinkler & Boyd, P.A., 15 S. Main St., Suite 500, Greenville, South Carolina 29601, (864) 467-1100.
(From The Bond Buyer)
